info.title: Tencent Finance Web Quote API
info.description: Undocumented, read-only Tencent Finance web endpoints observed on provider-owned quote pages. Snapshot responses are GBK-encoded JavaScript assignments; chart responses are JSON whose symbol and interval keys are dynamic. This is an evidence-labelled web interface, not an official developer API.

get.summary: Get one or more quote snapshots
get.description: Returns one `v_{symbol}="...";` JavaScript assignment per requested symbol. The quoted payload uses `~`-delimited, market-dependent positional fields (not CSV). Decode the response as GBK/GB18030 before parsing. Zero-based positions 1=name, 2=code, 3=latest, 4=previous close, 5=open, 30=time, 31=change, 32=change percent, 33=high and 34=low were rechecked across A-share, Hong Kong and US samples on 2026-08-10. Other positions and field counts vary by market and remain raw.

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: Comma-separated Tencent-prefixed security identifiers. Observed prefixes include `sh` (Shanghai), `sz` (Shenzhen), `hk` (Hong Kong) and `us` (US); examples: `sh600519`, `sz000001`, `hk00700`, `usAAPL`.

200.description: GBK-encoded JavaScript assignment text; despite the header sometimes reporting `text/html`, the body is not HTML.

get.x-pontx-stability-note: Verified with a read-only request on 2026-08-10. The response declared `text/html; charset=GBK` and contained `~`-delimited JavaScript assignments. Positional fields remain undocumented and market-dependent.

get.summary: Get K-line data with selectable adjustment
get.description: Returns JSON text under the currently observed `text/html; charset=UTF-8` media type. `data` is keyed by symbol. The series key is `qfq{interval}` for `qfq`, `hfq{interval}` for `hfq`, and the bare interval for `none`; for example `qfqday`, `hfqday`, or `day`. Each series contains `[date, open, close, high, low, volume]` tuples. `qt` contains raw quote arrays and `prec` is an undocumented provider field.
get.x-pontx-stability-note: Read-only request verified on 2026-08-10. Dynamic symbol/interval object keys and tuple positions are provider-internal and may change.

get.description: Returns JSON text under the currently observed `text/html; charset=UTF-8` media type. `data` is keyed by symbol; the requested `day`, `week`, or `month` key contains `[date, open, close, high, low, volume]` tuples. Requests using previously suspected `m1/m5/m15/m30/m60` values returned `code=1, msg=bad params` on 2026-08-10 and are therefore not advertised as supported.
get.x-pontx-stability-note: Read-only request verified on 2026-08-10. Dynamic symbol/interval object keys and tuple positions are provider-internal and may change.

KLineParam.name: param
KLineParam.description: Comma-delimited tuple `symbol,interval,start,end,count`. Empty start/end segments request recent candles. Confirmed intervals are `day`, `week`, and `month`. The provider may append the current partial candle in addition to the requested historical count. Intraday-looking values `m1/m5/m15/m30/m60` returned `bad params` in 2026-08-10 tests.

KLineParamAdjusted.name: param
KLineParamAdjusted.description: Comma-delimited tuple `symbol,interval,start,end,count,adjustment`. Empty start/end segments request recent candles. Confirmed intervals are `day`, `week`, and `month`; confirmed adjustment values are `qfq` (forward adjusted), `hfq` (backward adjusted), and `none` (unadjusted). The returned series key is prefixed for adjusted modes (`qfqday`/`hfqday`) and unprefixed for `none` (`day`).

KLineResponse.description: Successful JSON response. Candle arrays and raw quote values are mostly strings even when numeric.

code.description: Provider status code; observed success value is 0.

msg.description: Provider status message; empty on success.

data.description: Map keyed by requested Tencent symbol.

KLineSecurityData.title: KLineSecurityData
KLineSecurityData.description: Logical per-symbol payload. Series keys are `day/week/month`, or are prefixed with `qfq`/`hfq` on the adjusted route.

qt.description: Raw quote arrays keyed by symbol plus provider market-state data; fields remain deliberately unmodelled because they are market-dependent.

CandleSeries.title: CandleSeries
CandleSeries.description: Chronological candle tuples. The provider may append the current partial candle beyond `count`.

CandleTuple.title: CandleTuple
CandleTuple.description: Fixed six-value tuple in confirmed order: `[date, open, close, high, low, volume]`. Numeric values remain strings on the wire.

QuoteAssignmentWireText.title: QuoteAssignmentWireText
QuoteAssignmentWireText.description: Raw GBK-decoded JavaScript assignment text (`v_<symbol>="...";`), not JSON or HTML despite the response media type. Never execute it. Extract only the quoted value and split on `~`, preserving empty and unknown positions.

CommonQuotePositionalRecord.title: CommonQuotePositionalRecord
CommonQuotePositionalRecord.description: Logical cross-market subset parsed from one quote assignment. It is not the wire response. Positions are zero-based and were cross-checked against provider quote pages and live A-share/HK/US samples on 2026-08-10; all unconfirmed market-specific fields remain in `unmappedFields`.

time.description: Market-dependent timestamp representation (`YYYYMMDDhhmmss`, `YYYY/MM/DD HH:mm:ss`, or `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` observed).

changePercent.description: Percentage number without a percent sign.

unmappedFields.description: All original positions not mapped above; preserve their indexes and values verbatim.
